note: Top-down scope of the code thesaurus (thesaurus-v1): broad software-development categories whose core vocabulary seeds the head terms. Filtering happens after the PoC, so the scope is intentionally wide.

functions, methods, parameters, arguments, return values, closures, callbacks, scope, recursion, higher-order functions

type systems: generics, type parameters, type inference, unions, enums, nullability, casting, coercion, type checking

concurrency and parallelism: threads, locks, mutexes, semaphores, atomics, race conditions, deadlocks, thread pools, channels
